summary: Diginex Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing a share consolidation at an 8-for-1 ratio and an increase in authorized share capital, effective April 28, 2026. The consolidation reduces outstanding shares from ~232.8M to ~29.1M. No price per share, premium, or transaction value is stated because this is a routine capital restructuring, not a special situation. The board and shareholders approved the changes; no advisors are named. The move is likely to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance. There is no risk-arb angle as this is a mechanical adjustment with no change in proportional ownership.
